title: Make helper-note activity metadata explicit and testable
description: A visible, active helper assignment was silently excluded from LangGraph helper capacity because its durable note used display-only status text rather than the runner-parsed bullet metadata. Define the canonical manual-helper note metadata and add a focused regression test so active helper capacity stays truthful.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md gives a copyable manual helper-note metadata block with status, owner, scope, and creation fields, and names the active values recognized by the runner.
Graph documentation identifies helper-note metadata as the source of helper-capacity accounting and points to the canonical contract.
A focused regression test proves a manually authored active helper note is counted by scan_helper_notes, while a non-active note is not.
The focused regression test is included in run_tests.sh and passes with the existing runner.
